'''VYRUS''' was a [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]-scarred [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], VYRUS was present in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], where the [[Cularin Central Broadcasting]] reporter [[Ryk Osentay]] attempted to interview him. The Ugnaught became irritated and tried to leave, but Osentay blocked his path, so VYRUS kicked the reporter in the shin and then dragged him into a nearby alley, where he proceeded to beat Osentay up. The reporter later aired footage of the Ugnaught's attack on his show, [[Eye on Cularin]].
